title: PCSO Lotto Results: 6/55 prize tops P230M as no winners of major jackpot draws on September 28
summary: The Grand Lotto 6/55 prize is now over P230 million as there were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on September 28, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on…

blocks.text: The Grand Lotto 6/55 prize is now over P230 million as there were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on September 28, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday.
No bettor selected the winning combination of 48-15-44-37-34-33 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot prize that now stands at P230,978,278.61.

According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot are exactly 1 in 28,989,675. This means that for every single ticket combination a bettor buy, their chance of hitting all six numbers correctly is approximately 0.00000345%.
No one also chose the winning numbers of 21-14-19-38-40-02vfor the Megalotto 6/45 jackpot prize of P79,282,083.39.
